title: Samaṇa-brāhmaṇā
text: 2 Tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā || katamā tisso || || Sukhā vedanā || dukkhā vedanā || adukkhamasukhā vedanā || || 3 Ye hi kecī bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imāsaṃ tissannaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti || pe || || 4 ||pajānanti || pa || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || ||
